title: El-Hillow: We Should Get Comfortable With Higher Rates
snippet: Kate El-Hillow of Russell Investments said the recent jump in Treasury yields should not be viewed as purely temporary. In response to a question about whether the rise in yields might fade if geopolitical tensions ease, she argued investors should get comfortable with a "higher floor" and "rates for longer." She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Premium Sports Content Is Here To Stay: Fmr Hulu and Netflix Executive Simon Gallagher
snippet: Simon Gallagher of SPG Global discussed NBC regaining MLB rights and the league’s growing mix of broadcast and streaming distribution, including Peacock. He said the biggest issue is fragmentation: with roughly 2,500 baseball games, it is hard for viewers to figure out where a specific game is available, since rights are spread across multiple platforms. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
